content.short: MYRIAD embeds prediction markets directly into news sites and social feeds through a browser extension and publisher integrations.
content.description: MYRIAD is a multichain prediction market protocol from DASTAN, the media group formed by the merger of Decrypt and Rug Radio. Its distinguishing idea is distribution, not mechanism: instead of asking users to visit a separate exchange, a browser extension and publisher integrations embed live markets inside news articles, X, and YouTube where the underlying story is already being read. Markets settle onchain and the protocol runs across Abstract and Linea, keeping costs low enough for small consumer sized positions.
